pass01_findings.title: QA is distributed across completion workflow, evidence policy and completion readiness

pass01_findings.title: Invoice readiness exists but payment continuation is not directly linked from Jobs completion

pass01_findings.title: Recurring scheduling exists but cancellation/reschedule/rework are not one certified cleaning lifecycle
